n: Air Fry Over- the-Range Oven with Flush Built-in Design
desc: This microwave and air fryer combo crisps and caramelizes food with cooking modes like Air Fry Mode and Roast Mode. Monitor cooking progress while foods are in the microwave with Smart Features.* This flush mount microwave features a built-in design** that sits flush against cabinets to elevate your kitchen's style, while the Turntable-Free Design makes for easy cleaning after mealtime.
hl: Grill meat and vegetables in your microwave with Grill Mode.
Get effective ventilation and a smooth, easy-to-clean surface with Hidden Venting.
Easily add wire cooking racks and other accessories to the inside of your microwave with Accessory Tracks, which help elevate items so hot air can circulate around food.
Air Fry Mode gives you the flexibility of a microwave and air fryer in one appliance to free up counter space.
Roast Mode helps you give chicken, vegetables and more a crunchy, caramelized outer layer directly in the microwave, so you don’t have to use the oven.
When you’re busy in another room, use your smartphone to monitor cycle progress, so you’re ready to eat when dinner’s done.**Appliance must be set to remote enable.
